items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: No, I don't remember when he came there but I remember Punch Miller already. I didn't know where he came there.

ctx.x: Yeah. How about Punch Miller, excuse me. Punch Miller, do you remember Punch coming there?

No, I don't remember when he came there but I remember Punch Miller already. I didn't know where he came there. When did you first hear Joe Oliver? First time I heard Joe Oliver was in Pensacola when he came there I think it was. Yeah. Where did he play? He played at the hall there. Coyle Street Hall where I played at. What's the name of it? Coyle Street Hall. Call it Coyle Street. I forgot a map of Pensacola and I forgot what it looks like. Coyle Street Hall and then they had one on the Bella Street Hall, two…
Okay. While you're on Alabama let me ask one more question. Oh yeah, you keep asking us. Is that a place called Century, Alabama?
